rules.description: Each undamaged possessed Major Factory provides one technology roll. Damaged factories provide none. Each technology may be attempted only once per Calendar Turn.
Stage III cannot be developed before July 1939. A technology is immediately usable upon completion.
USA needs at least 10 IPP income for technology. Before 15 IPP income USSR can develop technology only via Rapid Industrialization or the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact.
Technology-unlocked units cannot be lend-leased, except the explicit Airborne Doctrine recipient conversion described on page 47.
